nodes.description: uint32 public _taxPercision = 100000; denominator used to compute tax (10**5, i.e. 100%).
address[] public _taxRecipients; list of addresses receiving distributed tax.
uint16 public _taxTotal; total tax percentage applied to taxed transfers.
bool public _taxActive; global switch enabling the tax logic.
mapping(address=>uint16) public _taxRecipientAmounts; per-recipient share used in distributeTaxes.
mapping(address=>bool) private _isTaxRecipient; membership flag for tax recipients.
mapping(address=>bool) public _whitelisted; addresses exempt from tax.
uint256 private _totalSupply; LOCKER total supply, set in the constructor.
LOCKER constructor: sets _totalSupply = 1e9 * 10**18 and mints it all to msg.sender.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom: spends allowance, applies tax to address(this) when active and neither party is whitelisted.
Overridden ERC20 transfer: applies tax to address(this) when active and neither party is whitelisted.
public burn(uint256) destroying tokens from msg.sender via _burn.
onlyOwner toggle of _taxActive.
onlyOwner add of a tax recipient and its tax amount; updates _taxTotal.
onlyOwner update of a recipient tax amount; adjusts _taxTotal up or down.
onlyOwner removal of a recipient via swap-and-pop loop; decreases _taxTotal.
onlyOwner addition of an address to the non-taxed whitelist.
onlyOwner removal of an address from the whitelist.
onlyOwner reset of tax state: deactivates tax, zeroes _taxTotal and clears _taxRecipients.
onlyOwner distribution of the contract's tax balance to recipients; last recipient receives the residual balance.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): caller identity used for minting, burning, spender/owner resolution and owner checks.
_mint(msg.sender, _totalSupply): mint of the entire supply to the deployer inside the constructor.
_burn(msg.sender, value): token destruction callable by any holder.
_transfer(from, address(this), tax) inside transferFrom: moves the tax portion to the contract itself.
_transfer(owner, address(this), tax) inside transfer: moves the tax portion to the contract itself.
_transfer(address(this), taxAddress, amount|balanceOf(this)) inside distributeTaxes loop.
Tax computation amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision and the _taxTotal +=/-= updates; unchecked-balance arithmetic class.
address from parameter of transferFrom.
address to parameter of transferFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of transferFrom.
address to parameter of transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer.
uint256 value parameter of burn.
address wallet parameter of addTaxRecipient.
uint16 _tax parameter of addTaxRecipient.
address wallet parameter of updateTaxPercentage.
uint16 newTax parameter of updateTaxPercentage.
address wallet parameter of removeTaxRecipient.
address wallet parameter of addToWhitelist.
address wallet parameter of removeFromWhitelist.
address spender = _msgSender() local in transferFrom.
uint256 tax = amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision local in transferFrom.
address owner = _msgSender() local in transfer.
uint256 tax = amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision local in transfer.
uint16 currentTax = _taxRecipientAmounts[wallet] local in updateTaxPercentage.
uint16 diff (newTax-currentTax or currentTax-newTax) local in updateTaxPercentage.
uint256 taxableAmount = balanceOf(address(this)) local in distributeTaxes.
address taxAddress = _taxRecipients[i] local in distributeTaxes.
uint256 amount = taxableAmount * _taxRecipientAmounts[taxAddress] / _taxTotal local in distributeTaxes.

edges.reason: constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender, the caller controls the recipient of the initial supply.
transferFrom resolves the spender via _msgSender() so the caller drives the allowance check and taxed transfer.
transfer resolves the owner via _msgSender() so the caller drives the taxed transfer.
burn passes msg.sender to _burn, letting any caller destroy their own balance.
toggleTax is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
addTaxRecipient is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
updateTaxPercentage is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
removeTaxRecipient is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
addToWhitelist is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
removeFromWhitelist is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
taxReset is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
distributeTaxes is gated by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
constructor writes _totalSupply = 1000000000 * 10**18.
constructor invokes _mint with the computed supply.
burn forwards its value parameter into _burn.
transferFrom sends the computed tax to address(this) via _transfer.
transferFrom computes tax = amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision, a multiplication/division on unvalidated inputs.
transfer sends the computed tax to address(this) via _transfer.
transfer computes tax = amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision, a multiplication/division on user-controlled amount.
distributeTaxes transfers the contract tax balance to each recipient via _transfer.
transferFrom reads _taxActive to decide whether tax applies.
transferFrom reads _whitelisted[from] and _whitelisted[to] for the tax exemption check.
transferFrom reads _taxTotal when computing the tax amount.
transferFrom reads _taxPercision as the tax denominator.
transfer reads _taxActive to decide whether tax applies.
transfer reads _whitelisted[owner] and _whitelisted[to] for the tax exemption check.
transfer reads _taxTotal when computing the tax amount.
transfer reads _taxPercision as the tax denominator.
toggleTax inverts and stores _taxActive.
addTaxRecipient bounds the new tax against _taxPercision/10.
addTaxRecipient pushes the wallet onto _taxRecipients.
addTaxRecipient accumulates _taxTotal = _taxTotal + _tax, a 16-bit addition that can overflow the 10% invariant.
addTaxRecipient stores the per-recipient tax in _taxRecipientAmounts.
addTaxRecipient sets _isTaxRecipient[wallet] = true.
updateTaxPercentage adds/subtracts diff from _taxTotal, an unchecked-invariant 16-bit update.
updateTaxPercentage writes the new per-recipient tax into _taxRecipientAmounts.
updateTaxPercentage requires _isTaxRecipient[wallet] before updating.
removeTaxRecipient swaps and pops entries of _taxRecipients.
removeTaxRecipient subtracts the removed tax from _taxTotal.
removeTaxRecipient zeroes _taxRecipientAmounts[wallet].
removeTaxRecipient clears _isTaxRecipient[wallet].
addToWhitelist sets _whitelisted[wallet] = true.
removeFromWhitelist sets _whitelisted[wallet] = false.
taxReset deletes the _taxRecipients array.
taxReset sets _taxTotal back to zero.
taxReset sets _taxActive back to false.
taxReset zeroes _taxRecipientAmounts for every recipient.
taxReset clears _isTaxRecipient for every recipient.
distributeTaxes iterates over _taxRecipients.
distributeTaxes divides taxableAmount by _taxTotal for each recipient share.
distributeTaxes reads _taxRecipientAmounts[taxAddress] as the weight.
from parameter flows into transferFrom allowance, balance and transfer logic.
to parameter flows into the final _transfer of transferFrom.
amount parameter feeds allowance spending and tax computation in transferFrom.
to parameter flows into the final _transfer of transfer.
amount parameter feeds balance check and tax computation in transfer.
value parameter flows into _burn in burn.
wallet parameter is validated and pushed into the recipient set in addTaxRecipient.
_tax parameter is bounded and added to _taxTotal in addTaxRecipient.
wallet parameter selects the recipient record in updateTaxPercentage.
newTax parameter is compared and applied in updateTaxPercentage.
wallet parameter selects the recipient to remove in removeTaxRecipient.
wallet parameter is whitelisted in addToWhitelist.
wallet parameter is removed from the whitelist in removeFromWhitelist.
transferFrom assigns _msgSender() to the local spender.
transferFrom assigns the computed tax to the local tax variable.
transfer assigns _msgSender() to the local owner.
transfer assigns the computed tax to the local tax variable.
updateTaxPercentage reads the current recipient tax into currentTax.
updateTaxPercentage computes diff from currentTax and newTax.
distributeTaxes snapshots balanceOf(address(this)) into taxableAmount.
distributeTaxes reads each recipient into the local taxAddress.
distributeTaxes computes the per-recipient share into the local amount.
the tax local computed in transferFrom is the value transferred to address(this).
the tax local is produced by amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision arithmetic.
the tax local computed in transfer is the value transferred to address(this).
the tax local is produced by amount * _taxTotal / _taxPercision arithmetic.
taxableAmount (and the residual balance on the last iteration) is what distributeTaxes transfers out.

normalization_plan.reason: address parameter is an input of transferFrom and has no standalone semantic identity.
address parameter belongs to the transferFrom signature.
uint256 amount parameter only exists to parameterise transferFrom.
address parameter belongs to the transfer signature.
uint256 amount parameter only exists to parameterise transfer.
value parameter only exists to parameterise burn.
wallet parameter belongs to the addTaxRecipient signature.
_tax parameter belongs to the addTaxRecipient signature.
wallet parameter belongs to the updateTaxPercentage signature.
newTax parameter belongs to the updateTaxPercentage signature.
wallet parameter belongs to the removeTaxRecipient signature.
wallet parameter belongs to the addToWhitelist signature.
wallet parameter belongs to the removeFromWhitelist signature.
local spender is just _msgSender() inside transferFrom.
local tax is the exact amount moved by the tax _transfer in transferFrom.
local owner is just _msgSender() inside transfer.
local tax is the exact amount moved by the tax _transfer in transfer.
currentTax is only the read-back of _taxRecipientAmounts inside updateTaxPercentage.
diff is a scratch value used for the _taxTotal update inside updateTaxPercentage.
taxableAmount is the snapshot of the contract balance inside distributeTaxes.
taxAddress is the loop element of _taxRecipients inside distributeTaxes.
local amount is the exact value passed to the _transfer performed by distributeTaxes.
